title: Book as a guest with a Stripe card
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/storefront/checkout-stripe.e2e.ts (nightly, needs Stripe test keys and stripe listen). Without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST / STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_TEST the card method is not offered. The dummy values of .env.example (sk_test_replace_me, pk_test_replace_me) count as unset too: the card method is not offered and creating a payment answers 424 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.

steps.title: Forward Stripe events
steps.body: Put your own Stripe **test** keys in `ota/backend/.env.local`, run `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/webhooks/stripe/velexis/test` and set the printed `whsec_…` as `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_VELEXIS_TEST`; restart.
steps.expect: `GET /v1/storefront` lists the card method with a `pk_test_…` publishable key.

steps.title: Search, price, checkout
steps.body: As in the airline-card flow; add one extra bag on the checkout page.
steps.expect: `PUT …/ancillaries` re-prices: `checkout_ancillaries`, a child `priced_offers` row, new totals.

steps.title: Card page
steps.body: The Payment Element loads. Use a 3-D Secure test card (e.g. 4000 0027 6000 3184).

steps.title: Pay and pass 3-D Secure
steps.expect: `POST …/complete` → `201`; booking `ticketed` (policy issue_after_payment); payment `captured`; webhooks add `payment_events` rows (`source = webhook`).

steps.title: Sold out at completion
steps.body: Repeat with header `X-Stub-Scenario: sold-out` on `checkout.complete` (outside production the API forwards it to the stub).
steps.expect: `409 SOLD_OUT`, booking `failed` (console only), payment `canceled`, PaymentIntent canceled at Stripe; the page says nothing was charged.

steps.title: Guest access
steps.body: Open the booking page in the same browser.
steps.expect: Works through the `__Host-vx_bt` cookie; documents downloadable through `/v1/files/…?exp=&sig=` links valid 5 minutes.
